  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow margin of 1–3 mm to allow histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral skin, and genitalia.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "The recommendation for primary excision of melanoma is supported by evidence from PubMed article PMID 30392755.",

  "The recommendation is for a narrow margin of 1–3 mm when excising suspected melanoma.",
